# OpenNolan

> OpenNolan is a Mac app where an AI agent turns your raw clips into a finished, scroll-stopping vertical video — Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts. The agent adds B-roll and images from the web, music, sound effects, burned-in captions, rapid cuts, and motion, all tuned for 9:16. You can fine-tune any cut afterward on a real timeline. It's built for founders and builders who need short-form video to get their product discovered but don't want to become video editors. Bring-your-own-key (you pay AI providers directly — no subscription, no markup), local-first and private, and open source. The app is in active development; the site is currently a waitlist.

## What OpenNolan is

- One sentence: a native macOS app where an AI agent makes the *whole* vertical reel from your clips, then hands you a real timeline if you want to tweak it.
- Who it's for: founders, indie hackers, SaaS teams, developers, agencies, and solopreneurs who'd rather ship product than learn video editing.
- How it's different: most tools give you better editing *tools*; OpenNolan's agent does the editing *for* you.
- Pricing model: bring-your-own-key — add your own AI provider API key and pay providers directly. No subscription, no markup, no account required. Open source.
- Status: in active development — [join the waitlist](https://www.opennolan.com/#waitlist) to be notified at launch.

## Built for

- [Founders](https://www.opennolan.com/for/founders): Ship scroll-stopping short-form as fast as you ship product.
- [Indie hackers](https://www.opennolan.com/for/indie-hackers): Make the whole reel without a subscription — bring your own key.
- [SaaS teams](https://www.opennolan.com/for/saas): Turn product clips into vertical video that gets discovered.
- [Developers](https://www.opennolan.com/for/developers): A local-first, open-source, BYOK video tool for people who ship code.
- [Agencies](https://www.opennolan.com/for/agencies): Produce more short-form per client without scaling an edit team.
- [Solopreneurs](https://www.opennolan.com/for/solopreneurs): One person, a finished reel — the agent does the editing.

## Compare

- [OpenNolan vs CapCut](https://www.opennolan.com/compare/capcut): AI agent that makes the whole reel vs a manual editor with templates.
- [OpenNolan vs Descript](https://www.opennolan.com/compare/descript): Agent-built reel vs transcript/document-based editing.
- [OpenNolan vs Opus Clip](https://www.opennolan.com/compare/opus-clip): Create a reel from raw clips vs repurpose long video into clips.
- [OpenNolan vs Submagic](https://www.opennolan.com/compare/submagic): The whole vertical video vs captions-and-effects on your edit.
- [OpenNolan vs Veed](https://www.opennolan.com/compare/veed): Local Mac agent vs a browser-based editor.
- [OpenNolan vs Adobe Premiere Pro](https://www.opennolan.com/compare/adobe-premiere): An agent for founders vs a pro manual NLE.
- [OpenNolan vs Final Cut Pro](https://www.opennolan.com/compare/final-cut-pro): A Mac-native AI agent for founders vs Apple's pro manual editor.
